dedupe_keys.name: matlab codes for cloud ida msa conversion of fragility curves

description: Yutao Pang publishes MATLAB functions for converting structural fragility curves between cloud analysis, incremental dynamic analysis and multiple-stripe analysis. The February 2021 Zenodo ZIP is freely downloadable; Zenodo labels it Other Open, while the linked repository identifies GPL-3.0. The README names an example for extensive damage, a conversion function using two fragility points and a function selecting candidate intensity measures. These routines can compare alternative fragility-estimation assumptions in infrastructure seismic-risk simulations. Coverage is generic, not a specific country or observation period. Applicability outside the paper’s assumptions, numerical stability and MATLAB-version compatibility remain uncertain. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these conversion functions. The linked structural-engineering paper is the describing citation. Only public metadata and README documentation were inspected; code and validation examples were not executed.
